commons.title: Sombe sauce served with kalo and avocado.jpg
commons.description: Sombe sauce with meat and ovacado in it. Sombe is made using pounded cassava leaves and prepared with palm oil and any type of meat of fish. It is commonly eaten among the Bakonzo, Batooro and Banyoro in Uganda.
commons.editorial_reason: Food is explicitly described as commonly eaten among the Bakonzo and categorized under Konjo people.
